## Requirements

<a id="BreathOf"></a>

### The breath of a moment

`BreathOf` · `src/product.ts:76` · status: **held**

The breath a moment of a practice follows: the setting of the most specific level that has one (an exercise, then the step, then the sequence, then the pose), applied to the person's pattern, or to the default one.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
(person: BreathPattern | undefined, levels: readonly (BreathSetting | undefined)[]): BreathPattern => {
    const base = person ?? DefaultBreath.value
    const setting = levels.find((x) => x !== undefined)
    const each = (f: (phase: BreathPhase) => Duration): BreathPattern =>
      ({ inhale: f(BreathPhase.inhale), holdTop: f(BreathPhase.holdTop), exhale: f(BreathPhase.exhale), holdBottom: f(BreathPhase.holdBottom) })
    if (!setting || "follows" in setting) return base
    if ("exact" in setting) return setting.exact
    if ("speed" in setting) return each((p) => base[p] / setting.speed)
    return each((p) => (setting.ratio[p] * base.inhale) / setting.ratio.inhale)
  }
```

</details>

- Refines: [The breath sets the pace](#BreathSetsThePace)
- Depends on: [The breath of someone who has set nothing](#DefaultBreath)
- Used by: [A practice](practice.md#PracticeOf)
- Applies: [The breath is the clock](principles.md#BreathIsTheClock)
- Used by: [Sequences](content.md#Sequences)

**Criteria of the breath of a moment · owner: ghalaax**

| Criterion | Result |
|---|---|
| Without any setting, the person's own breath | passed |
| The most specific level wins: an exercise's exact timings over its pose's ratio | passed |
| A ratio is scaled on the person's inhale: the exhale twice as long | passed |
| Twice the speed halves each phase | passed |

<a id="ChosenLanguage"></a>

### The language of the app

`ChosenLanguage` · `src/product.ts:137` · status: **held**

The one the person chose, if it is offered; otherwise the first of the device's languages that is offered; otherwise the first language offered.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
(offered: readonly string[], chosen: string | undefined, device: readonly string[]): string => {
    const base = (tag: string) => tag.split("-")[0]
    if (chosen !== undefined && offered.includes(chosen)) return chosen
    return device.map(base).find((tag) => offered.includes(tag)) ?? offered[0]
  }
```

</details>

- Refines: [In the person's language](#InTheirLanguage)
- Used by: [The app's language](language.md#AppLanguage)
- Applies: [The person's language, among those offered](principles.md#LanguageOffered)

<a id="HoldInBreaths"></a>

### A hold counts in breaths

`HoldInBreaths` · `src/product.ts:111` · status: **held**

A hold written in seconds lasts the whole number of breaths nearest to it, and at least one, so that the end of a hold always falls at the end of a breath.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
(hold: Duration, breath: BreathPattern): number => {
    const length = breath.inhale + breath.holdTop + breath.exhale + breath.holdBottom
    return Math.max(1, Math.round(hold / length))
  }
```

</details>

- Refines: [The breath sets the pace](#BreathSetsThePace)
- Applies: [The breath is the clock](principles.md#BreathIsTheClock)

<a id="HoldInBreathsCriteria"></a>

**Criteria of a hold in breaths · owner: ghalaax**

| Criterion | Result |
|---|---|
| Thirty seconds at eight seconds a breath is four breaths | passed |
| A hold is never shorter than one breath | passed |

## Decision

<a id="DefaultBreath"></a>

### The breath of someone who has set nothing

`DefaultBreath` · `src/product.ts:65`

The pattern a practice follows until the person sets their own, in the settings or by tapping their breath: four seconds in, four seconds out, no pause at the top or at the bottom. A product decision.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| inhale | 4 |
| holdTop | 0 |
| exhale | 4 |
| holdBottom | 0 |

- Decided by: ghalaax
- Rejected: A timer in seconds, the person would follow a clock instead of their breath
- Used by: [Show the settings](settings.md#ShowSettings)
- Used by: [Poses](content.md#Poses), [The breath of a moment](#BreathOf)
